# GitHub Copilot Agent Infrastructure — front-backbone-rest

Master index for the agent infrastructure. Generated by `bootstrap-web-agent-infrastructure.prompt.md`.

## Project Snapshot

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Name | front-backbone-rest |
| Framework | Angular 20.3 |
| Language | TypeScript 5.9 strict |
| Package manager | npm |
| BFF | Express 5.2.1 (`server.js` + `server/routes/`) |
| State management | NgRx 20 (session) + Angular Signals (local) |
| Styling | Tailwind CSS v4 |
| Auth | `session-token` header via `authInterceptor` → `StorageMockService` |

| i18n | `@ngx-translate/core` 16, default language `es` |
| Test framework | Jasmine 5 + Karma 6 (`@angular/build:karma`) |
| Static analysis | TypeScript 5.9 strict only (no ESLint) |
| Formatting | Prettier (`printWidth: 100`, `singleQuote: true`) |
| SSR | `@angular/ssr` → `dist/front-backbone-rest/server/server.mjs` |
| CI/CD | None configured |
| Docker | None |

## Request Flow (layer diagram)

```
Browser / Angular SSR
     │
     │  Tailwind v4 inline templates
     │  @if / @for / @let — Angular new control flow
     │  signal() — local state   NgRx session — global auth state
     ▼
Angular Component
  inject(FeatureService)
     │
     ▼
Feature Service                  SessionStoreService (NgRx facade)
  inject(HttpService)            ├─ isAuthenticated$
  API.ENTITY.* constants         ├─ token$
     │                           └─ save / clear / refresh
     ▼
HttpService  ──── authInterceptor (attaches session-token header)
  wraps HttpClient               errorInterceptor (401→login, 403→forbidden)
  base: /api (environment)
     │
     │  HTTP to same host: /api/v1/*
     ▼
Express BFF (server.js — port 4000)
  Rate limiter → CORS → JSON body
  app.use('/api/v1/<entity>', <entity>Routes)
     │
     ▼
server/routes/<entity>.routes.js
  proxyToBackbone(req, res, '/api/v1/<entity>/...')
     │
     ▼
server/shared/proxy.js (axios)
  BACKBONE_BASE_URL/api/v1/*
     │
     ▼
backbone-rest API (upstream)
```

## Quick Start — 3 Most Common Tasks

### 1. Add a new entity end-to-end (API + service + component + tests)

Invoke the **Orchestrator** with `full-feature-delivery.prompt.md`:

```
featureName = "document"
backboneBasePath = "/api/v1/documents"
httpMethods = "GET list, GET by id, POST, PUT, DELETE"
securityScan = "no"
```

The orchestrator delegates: api-designer → developer → test-writer → code-reviewer → quality gate.

### 2. Add a single Angular component

Invoke the **Developer** with `implement-component.prompt.md`:

```
componentName = "DocumentBadge"
componentSelector = "document-badge"
featurePath = "src/app/features/documents/document-badge"
componentPurpose = "Displays a document status badge with Tailwind styling"
services = "DocumentService"
```

### 3. Run the pre-PR quality gate manually

```bash
npx tsc --noEmit && npm run test:headless && npm run build:ssr
```

Then invoke **Code Reviewer** with `review-code.prompt.md`, passing the list of changed files.

---

## Agent Invocation Reference

| Agent | When to use |
|-------|------------|
| `@orchestrator` | Complex multi-layer features, need all agents coordinated |
| `@developer` | Single component, service, BFF route, or bug fix |
| `@test-writer` | Write or improve Jasmine tests |
| `@api-designer` | New BFF route or API constant alignment |
| `@code-reviewer` *(subagent)* | Called by orchestrator or pre-PR hook |
| `@security-reviewer` *(subagent)* | Called by orchestrator or post-merge hook |
